proof_body:
by
  intro K Γ _ _ v x hx
  have h0 : v x ≠ 0 := (v.ne_zero_iff).mpr hx
  rw [map_inv₀]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine le_antisymm h1 ?_
    exact (inv_le_one₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr h0)).mp h2
  · intro h
    simp [h]
target_source: ∀ (K Γ : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (v : Valuation K Γ) (x : K), x ≠ 0 → ((v x ≤ 1 ∧ v x⁻¹ ≤ 1) ↔ v x = 1)
